standard_prerequisites: The relative assassin of a finite type module over the base, and its description as the set of points whose fibre point is associated to the fibre of the module
Etale charts of a decent space and the lifting of specialisations from the space to the chart
The schemes version of the statement, identifying the associated points of the special fibre of the pullback with the fibre of the relative assassin
core_obligations: Take a point of the closed fibre which is a specialisation of the given associated point in the underlying space

Choose an etale chart through that point and lift the specialisation to a specialisation in the chart, noting that the image of the lifted point is the given associated point and hence that the lifted point lies in the relative assassin of the pulled back module

Apply the schemes version of the statement inside the chart to obtain a specialisation to a point of the relative assassin over the closed point of the base, and push that point down to the space, where it lies in the relative assassin and over the closed point, which is the desired conclusion
proof_roadmap: Choose a point of the closed fibre in the closure of the given associated point
Lift the specialisation along an etale chart and apply the schemes version inside the chart
Push the resulting associated point down to the space
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the meeting of the relative assassin with the closed fibre along a closure at source lines 997-1006, label lemma-associated-point-specializes, whose proof occupies source lines 1008-1028. The proof reduces the statement to the case of schemes through an etale chart, and the reduction is where the content lies: one must lift a specialisation from the space to the chart, which uses the decentness of the space, and one must recognise the lifted point as a point of the relative assassin of the pulled back module, which uses the description of the relative assassin through the associated points of the fibres. The schemes version is then applied inside the chart, and the resulting point is pushed back down to give an associated point of the original closed fibre in the closure. The counted statement records neither the lift nor the identification of the relative assassin.
